added.summary: Generates and indexes `ui-tsx` (every export of `@origingame/engine/ui`: primitives, hooks, signals, `HostProps`, `UiEvent`), `theme-tokens` (default pack colour roles, theme scales with the utilities that read each, `packClass` slots, sounds, images, and built-in icons) and `playtest` (every export of `@origingame/engine/playtest`) guides from source in `og api gen`/`og api check`.

Documents `og sfx` and the `type sfx` entries (`audio §9`), `type rig2d` 2D auto-rigging templates (`animation §14`), built-in `@canvas/*` and `@palettes/*` look assets (`looks §20`), and theme authoring commands (`themes §6`).
